channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Flip Saunders | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Flip Saunders from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Stephon Marbury on Flip Saunders
item.description:
Stephon Marbury:

“I think communication was lackluster because I left one place where I had a father figure in Flip Saunders and it was structurally set up the proper way, which is why I see why a lot of people they get upset about me leaving and going to another team. I think for me, I had someone who educated me in the game of basketball. He taught me the game the proper way from every angle, from every aspect, from pick and rolls, from when you're supposed to, from foul line extended, coming off tight, one two dribble, no hop, all of these little things in basketball that you need to know in order to be able to go on the court to dominate.”

Stephon Marbury on Flip Saunders, May 30, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Karl-Anthony Towns on Flip Saunders
item.description:
“I made a promise to Flip Saunders that I would win and I would end the playoff drought, and I intend to do that and keep my promise,”

Karl-Anthony Towns on Flip Saunders, Oct 22, 2017. Source: St. Paul Pioneer Press.

item.title: Craig Sager on Flip Saunders
item.description:
Sam Amick:Sager:

“I was really devastated by Flip Saunders... I tried calling (him) this weekend and I couldn't get through.”

Craig Sager on Flip Saunders, Oct 28, 2015. Source: Twitter @sam_amick.

item.title: Masai Ujiri on Flip Saunders
item.description:
Ryan Wolstat:Masai Ujiri on Flip Saunders:

“We lost a great coach but an even better person. This one hits home. He is gone too early. Our thoughts and prayers go out to his family and the Timberwolves organization. May his soul rest in peace.”

Masai Ujiri on Flip Saunders, Oct 25, 2015. Source: Twitter @WolstatSun.

item.title: Pat Riley on Flip Saunders
item.description:
Ira Winderman:Riley statement on passing of Flip Saunders,

“Flip Saunders was and always will be family. He was part of a gigantic NBA family where we all competed with a fierce respect, integrity and staunch character. It is with great sadness I want to send his family and the Timberwolves our prayers, compassion and sympathy to all.‘Our Father who art in Heaven, Hallowed be thy name. Flip Saunders soul and the heart of his family and loved ones are now in the forever hands of The Lord. May Flip Saunders rest in peace.”

Pat Riley on Flip Saunders, Oct 25, 2015. Source: Twitter @IraHeatBeat.

item.title: Tyus Jones on Flip Saunders
item.description:
“When I heard that news, it was definitely pretty sad. I reached out to Coach Saunders, just let him know I was praying for him and I’m with him — that he would get through this.“He’s fighting it. He’s in good spirits and he’ll definitely get through this and still be part of this team, this organization in a big way like he has been.”

Tyus Jones on Flip Saunders, Sep 17, 2015. Source: WCTrib.com.

item.title: Glen Taylor on Flip Saunders
item.description:
“This year, knowing that I have (coach Flip Saunders), knowing we have some really good resources, I just understand we're going to go through part of our growing process,”

Glen Taylor on Flip Saunders, Dec 14, 2014. Source: St. Paul Pioneer Press.

item.title: Nick Young on Flip Saunders
item.description:
“But I've been through the trenches with JaVale and Coach Saunders, and I want JaVale to keep his head. I don't want him to get down.”

Nick Young on Flip Saunders, Jan 16, 2012. Source: SB Nation.
